args.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/'workspace/rule_lab/rules.yaml'
data=json.loads(p.read_text())
data['risk']={'velocity_window_s':60,'min_risk_to_review':0.82,'max_attempts':5,'blocked_region':'ZZ'}
p.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2)+'\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
curl -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18119/reload

curl -sS -D /tmp/risk_headers.txt http://127.0.0.1:18119/evaluate/risk -o ~/workspace/rule_lab/out/risk_report.json; cat /tmp/risk_headers.txt; echo '--- report'; cat ~/workspace/rule_lab/out/risk_report.json; echo; echo '--- validate'; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/'workspace/rule_lab/out/risk_report.json'
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
print('saved',p,'bytes',p.stat().st_size)
print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
PY
